notes.title: New Update Released
notes.content:
Hi! We've released a new version of Escape From Tethys with some small (oft-requested) changes!

- The player character movement is now "absolute". No more inertia, no more sliding.
- Raised the rates at which early enemies drop health/ammo
- Made the save point after the first boss more noticeable
- Fixed issue where moving to another room would sometimes freeze the player
- Fixed issue where teleporting while on conveyor belt would persist conveyor movement

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Patch Released!
notes.content:
- Easier mode is now easier! "Butterflies" in the volcano area won't always spawn.
- Added save deleting to the main menu.
- Crates can no longer push you into the ground.
- Pausing is disabled while teleporting.
- Fixed the tech expert achievement.
- Fixed a few upgrade icons to show the proper icon
